📖 How to use

  1. Place your 5 ships manually or press Auto-place.
  2. Press Start Battle when your fleet is deployed.
  3. Tap enemy waters to fire — 🔥 hit, · miss.
  4. Sink all 5 enemy ships before yours are sunk!

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which ships are in the game?

Carrier (5), Battleship (4), Cruiser (3), Submarine (3), and Destroyer (2) — 17 ship cells each side.

How do I place my ships?

Pick a ship, choose horizontal or vertical, and click your grid — or press Auto-place to deploy instantly.

How smart is the computer opponent?

It uses hunt-and-target tactics: random probing, then zeroing in on neighbors once it scores a hit.

How do I win?

Sink all 5 enemy ships before it sinks yours. Sunk ships are announced in the battle log.
